name: SurrealDB

evidence.nosql: C02: multi-model database with document and graph queries; D01: SurrealQL records and graph relations
evidence.backend: C07: database, custom signin and JWT access, file buckets and custom functions in one product
evidence.files: F01: file buckets on self-hosted and hosted tiers; F04: HTTP upload default up to 5 GiB
evidence.vector: V01: HNSW vector indexes with declared dimensions; V02: vector search with filters and RRF

line: Multi-model database with auth, file buckets, functions, and vector indexes.

free.text: Earth Free: 3M units, 10GB, 100h/mo; pauses at quota until next month

cells.regions: AWS and Azure regions; region locked at creation
cells.selfhost: Yes, BSL 1.1; service-hosting rights are restricted

sql.math: $98.55 for compute + $0.36 for egress. Disk, backup and tax costs are still unknown.
A manual pause keeps the data and stops instance usage charges, but the database address (endpoint) is unavailable.

files.math: File buckets are included, but their storage price is unclear. Earth Pro's $33.75 applies only if its database usage charge applies.

jobs.math: Jobs use database capacity. No separate worker price exists, and whether five jobs running at once fit, and the total, are unknown.
